children: VantageScore President and Chief Executive Silvio Tavares is stepping down from his roles after leading the company for five years, the credit-scoring company said.

Anthony Hutchinson, who led the company's public affairs and government relations efforts, was named as interim president and CEO. VantageScore's board is conducting a formal leadership search, the company added.
Hutchinson joined VantageScore four years ago. Before that, he held senior positions at Freddie Mac, Fannie Mae and the National Association of Realtors, the company said.
VantageScore is an independent joint-venture company owned by Equifax, Experian and TransUnion.
